import html # The HTML template containing a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Content

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def create_html_output(input_text: str) -> str: """ Safely embed user-provided text into an HTML template. Args: input_text: The raw content supplied by the user. Returns: A complete HTML string with the escaped user content inserted. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS and injection attacks safe_content = html.escape(input_text, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
